Before you connect

You need Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon installed. A vanilla client or a different modpack will not have the mods required to join.

How to join

  1. Install the Mythforge pack using the Getting Started guide.
  2. Launch the matching version and open Multiplayer.
  3. Apply through the whitelist form and wait for server-confirmed approval.
  4. Select Mythforge Official Server if it is already listed, or add play.mythforge.win manually, and join.

Good to know

Server questions, answered.

Can I join with vanilla Minecraft?

No. Install Mythforge and use the same pack version as the server.

Which version should I use?

The required version is 1.3.1. Install the latest published release; the server follows the latest version.

What happens if I cannot connect?

Verify the server address and modpack version, restart the game, and check maintenance announcements. See troubleshooting for more help.

Can I support the server?

The supporter page explains current ranks and rewards. Read the full package descriptions, commands and restrictions on the supporter page, then continue to the official Tebex storefront. All supporter rewards can also be earned through gameplay.

Mythforge’s engineering, magic, building and adventure are designed with multiplayer in mind. Build a workshop together, compare magical discoveries or prepare for the next boss as a group. The live official server at play.mythforge.win gives that freedom a shared home.
